messages:
Anika (partnerships): Heads-up 1: VertexHW x Marketplace joint webinar locked for Jun 3 11am PT. Need to finalize speaker times, demo redundancy, logistics for international swag. Quick coordination thread here.
Tom (events): Draft run-of-show uploaded to Drive. We need speaker bios (1 paragraph), slide deck by May 20, and AV preflight on Jun 1.
Nina - VertexHW: I'll do a 7min keynote focused on hardware co-design. We can also provide a 6min recorded demo as backup.
Omar (devrel): Happy to cover the Redwood integration demo live for 10min. I'll also record a 6min fallback showing model swap and routing policies.
Priya (solutions): For the live demo, can we confirm whether we pull telemetry to Redwood Console? We should show latency histogram and cost per token briefly.
Omar (devrel): Yes, we'll show a dashboard tile for latency and a short cost-per-token screenshot. Using synthetic dataset.
Joel - Marketplace: We need a marketplace CTA slide and a listing promo code. Also request a one-line compliance statement.
Maya (swag-ops): International shipping note: EU and UK customs need HS codes for textile items. Will avoid lithium batteries. Propose swag: 250 bundles (pin + notebook + Vertex-branded micro-USB cable). Can we do printed quickstart in three languages (EN/DE/FR)?
Nina - VertexHW: English + German is fine; French optional. We'll approve translations.
Anika (partnerships): Action list: bios by May 10, slides by May 20, pre-records by May 24, swag list + addresses by May 25.
Tom (events): We trimmed show: 11:00 intro (Anika, 2m) -> Keynote (Nina, 7m) -> Live demo (Omar, 10m) -> Marketplace/CTA (Joel, 5m) -> Q&A (11m) -> Close (Anika, 2m). That fits a 40-minute slot. Any objections?
Priya (solutions): Can we allocate 3 extra minutes for Q&A if we shorten keynote to 5m?
Nina - VertexHW: Fine to go 5m. We'll tighten slides.
Omar (devrel): I'll compress demo to 8m if needed.
Anika (partnerships): Great. Tom will run the AV test June 1 at 9am PT. Event-bot: "AV preflight Jun 1 9am PT" scheduled.
Maya (swag-ops): Shipping: need final shipping list by May 25. For EU/UK we need company VAT numbers to clear customs for 80 units. Send to me via secure doc.
Joel - Marketplace: Landing page draft posted. Proposed UTM: ?utm_source=vertex&utm_campaign=jun3_joint. Promo code: VERTEX50 (first 50 signups).
Priya (solutions): Security: demos must not send logs with prompt text to third-party telemetry. Omar confirm data scrubber on.
Omar (devrel): Confirmed  data scrubber on and logs masked. We'll also include a slide: "No customer data used."
Maya (swag-ops): Request: one sample bundle to Vertex EU office for customs check. Ship to: VertexLabs EU Ops, 12 Rue de Fabrication, Berlin 10115.
Nina - VertexHW: We'll sign off on sample once received.
Tom (events): Rehearsal schedule: Jun 1 9am PT (AV) + Jun 2 10am PT (full run). Calendar invites will go out.
Anika (partnerships): Please mark deliverables DONE in thread. I'll compile final runbook after May 25.
Omar (devrel): I'll upload my recorded fallback by May 24 (DONE when uploaded).
Nina - VertexHW: Keynote pre-record done and uploaded today.
Joel - Marketplace: Landing page live: https://market.example/partners/vertex-redwood?utm_source=vertex&utm_campaign=jun3_joint
Tom (events): Calendar invites sent. Event-bot: RSVP summary to be posted 48h in advance.
Maya (swag-ops): Reminder: no electronics, only textile + cable accessory. Send VAT numbers in secure doc.
Priya (solutions): Post-event: let's produce a technical appendix doc and link to it from the landing page.
Omar (devrel): Also adding a quick curl snippet to the deck backup slides:
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/completions -H "Authorization: Bearer <KEY>" -d '{"model":"redwood-alpha","prompt":"test"}'
```
Anika (partnerships): Thanks all. Re-opening if blockers. :party_popper:
